equipment.name: Banner of the Eagle
equipment.desc: This model and its attached unit gain +1 Strength. Character only. Unique.

equipment.name: Chogorian Dreadplate
equipment.desc: This model gains a 3+ ward save against any wounds caused by models with the "Daemon", "Greater Daemon" or "Psyker" abilities. Unique.

equipment.name: Cyber-Eagle Helm
equipment.desc: This model and its attached unit does not suffer the To Hit penalty for Defensive Fire.

equipment.name: Cyber-hawk
equipment.desc: At the beginning of its activation, this model may designate an enemy unit within 24". Until the end of its activation, this model and its attached unit may re-roll ranged to hit rolls of 1 when firing at the designated unit, and gain the "Move through cover" ability while making a Charge move towards the designated unit.

equipment.name: Hunter's Eye
equipment.desc: All ranged attacks by this model and its attached unit have the Seeking ability. Unique.

equipment.name: Mantle of the Stormseer
equipment.desc: This model gains +1 to manifest and deny psychic powers. Unique.

equipment.name: Plume of the Plainsrunner
equipment.desc: This model and its attached unit gain the cumulative Frenzy(1") and Haste(1") abilities. Unique.

equipment.name: Shamshir Jetbike (Scatterbolt launcher)
equipment.desc: The model gains +6" movement, +1 Toughness, +1 Wound, a 2+ Armor save, a Scatterbolt launcher and the "Jet Bike" type. Only for infantry.

equipment.name: Stormwrath Bolts
equipment.desc: When firing a bolt weapon, this model may choose to fire a Stormwrath bolt instead of attacking normally. Use their bolt weapon's range and the profile above.

equipment.name: Enhanced engines
equipment.desc: This vehicle automatically advances 6" when given an Advance order.

equipment.name: Chogorian Brotherhood
equipment.desc:
- Legion Outrider Squadron and Legion Sky-hunter Squadron units may be taken as Troops.
- All Bike and Jet Bike units gain the "Hit and Run" ability.
- All Infantry units gain the "Outflank" ability.
- All units with less than 12" Movement may only be deployed at the start of the game as passengers inside a transport.

equipment.name: Sagyar Mazan
equipment.desc:
- Ebon Keshig Cohort units may be taken as Troops.
- All Creature units must be upgraded to gain the "Blind Rage" ability for +5 points per unit.
- Heavy Support units with the Vehicle unit type may not be taken.
- The army may not choose to start the game with any units in Reserve. Units which cannot begin the game deployed on the table cannot be taken.
